integrity.claim: Exact finite bridge decomposition, nongate and gate source centered distribution limits, nongate moment limits and leading mean ratio.
integrity.computational_checks: 96 passing assertions in standalone checker.py; no finite test substitutes for an asymptotic proof.
integrity.method: Exact Markov/exponential order representation plus compact-rank asymptotics and uniform exponential moment bounds.

scientific_limitations: Fixed positive bridge rate; equal complete communities; independent exponential edge passage times of intra-clique rate 1/n; no multi-bridge or non-Markovian extension; historical priority not independently certified.
title: Gate-sensitive flooding on a weighted barbell: a logistic–Gumbel limit
